d: We are looking for a proactive, analytical, and strategic-minded Customer Strategy Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will be responsible for analyzing customer behavior, developing customer engagement strategies, identifying growth opportunities, and supporting initiatives that improve customer acquisition, satisfaction, retention, and long-term loyalty.
Assist in developing and implementing customer strategies aligned with business objectives.
Analyze customer data, preferences, purchasing patterns, and behavioral trends to identify business opportunities.
Develop strategies to improve customer acquisition, engagement, retention, and loyalty.
Conduct customer segmentation and identify key customer groups based on demographics, preferences, and purchasing behavior.
Monitor customer satisfaction, retention rates, churn rates, and other customer-related KPIs.
Evaluate customer journeys and identify opportunities to improve the overall customer experience.
Conduct market research and competitor analysis to understand changing customer expectations and industry trends.
Develop customer engagement initiatives, loyalty programs, and retention campaigns.
Collaborate with marketing, sales, customer service, and product development teams to execute customer-focused strategies.
Analyze campaign performance and assess the effectiveness of customer engagement initiatives.
Identify customer pain points and recommend strategies to improve satisfaction and reduce churn.
Prepare customer strategy reports, presentations, and performance dashboards for management.
Provide data-driven recommendations to support business growth and strengthen customer relationships.
Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Management Sciences, or a relevant field.
1–3 years of experience in customer strategy, customer insights, business analysis, marketing, or a related role.
Strong analytical, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Good understanding of customer lifecycle management, segmentation, and retention strategies.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Familiarity with CRM platforms, customer analytics tools, and data visualization software such as Power BI or Tableau will be an advantage.
Understanding of customer experience metrics, including NPS, CSAT, churn rate, and customer lifetime value (CLV).
Excellent communication, research, and presentation skills.
Ability to translate customer data into actionable business recommendations.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple initiatives.
A forward-thinking individual with a strong customer-centric mindset.
Someone who understands customer behavior and can identify opportunities for business growth.
Strong analytical abilities with an interest in developing effective customer strategies.
A proactive problem-solver who focuses on improving customer engagement and loyalty.
Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
Someone passionate about creating meaningful customer experiences and driving long-term business value.
